package.description: Open with one click. Use classroom management tools anywhere.

en-US.description: Open with one click. Use classroom management tools anywhere.
en-US.longDescription:
When you install Gynzy to your computer, you’ll be able to:
- Access Gynzy quickly and easily from an icon on your desktop or dock
- Use the Glassplate feature to overlay Gynzy tools "on top" of other websites and applications
- Drag and drop images into your lessons
en-US.name: Gynzy Desktop

zh-CN.description: 一键开启。随处使用课堂管理工具。
zh-CN.longDescription:
将 Gynzy 安装到电脑后，您将能够：
- 通过桌面或程序坞的图标快速便捷地访问 Gynzy
- 使用“Glassplate”功能将 Gynzy 工具叠加在其他网站和应用程序上方
- 通过拖放图片快速构建课程内容
